mods.name: Ex³ Companion
mods.description: A loyal floating companion: craft its core, slot it in, and it follows you on your adventures.

releases.notes:
Ex3 Companion v1.4.3 for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric).

Everything in this release:

New
- tint the core itself and drop the enchantment glint
- unlock every retint recipe as soon as the core is obtained
- tint the dye recipe's book preview with a re-rolling colour
- server-only config with operator gating and hidden Mod Menu settings (v1.4.0)
- split GUI settings into client/server tabs with operator gating and network sync (v1.3.4)
- rename companion via anvil — core item custom name applied to the spawned companion
- emotion system, slime targeting, tooltip polish, and progression rebalance (v1.3.0)
- combat awareness, flight improvements, and regen rebalance (v1.2.0)
- glass tinting, combat modes, priority targeting, and bug fixes (v1.1.0)
- initial release v1.0 — companion mod for Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric)

Fixed
- scope the recipe book tooltip suppression to the book itself
- only hide the core stat block while the recipe book is open
- keep the core stat block outside the recipe book only
- restore the sponge recipe so the retint variants popup can open
- show companion core recipes in the vanilla recipe book
- correct flight collisions, stuck recovery and per-tick scanning cost
- harden companion slot sync against client-forged state (v1.4.2)
- despawn companion when core leaves its slot (v1.4.1)
- restrict client screen mixins to client-side in mixin config, preventing dedicated server crash (v1.3.2)
- remove hardcoded org.gradle.java.home from project gradle.properties

Changed
- rename the core models to core_<colour> as well
- fold the sponge recipe into the dye recipe, making retint a single entry
- merge the 16 dye recipes into one and group tint variants

Tests
- lock the recipe-book grouping of the tint recipes
- add JVM unit tests and JUnit build wiring

Docs
- rewrite README, update DEVELOPMENT with accurate structure and dev caveats

Build & CI
- drop the TODO file
- generate the release notes from the git history
- add a manual create-release workflow and refresh the actions
- switch the licence to MIT and trim the README
- bump version to 1.4.3
- update all dependencies to latest and enable JEI in dev
- bump version to 1.3.5 (Minecraft 26.3)
- update to Minecraft 26.3, Loom 1.18.1 and Gradle 9.7.1 with API compatibility fixes, translatable option descriptions (v1.3.4)
- update dependencies to latest stable versions, drop CurseForge dev mods (v1.3.1)

Other changes
- Restore vanilla one-recipe-per-tint layout for companion retinting
